name: Art or collectibles held in free ports without display or trade
description: Artworks are acquired and stored long term in free ports with no movement, display or documented purpose.

links.name: Art or collectibles held in free ports without display or trade
links.ctx: Art, wine, precious metals or collectibles remain in a free-port or bonded warehouse for long periods with no display, sale or loan.

links.name: Storage in free ports without display or trade
links.ctx: Artworks stored for long without movement.
